kiel-schlei-kappeln-eckernfoerde-arc.story: Fjord air, small bridges and north-coast rhythm. The best part sits around Eckernförde bay, Schwansen backroads, Kappeln Schlei bridge, while Schleswig food stop keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.
